v4::en::EMO是一种新型专家混合模型，通过端到端预训练使模块化结构直接从: EMO is a new expert hybrid model that enables modular structures to emerge directly from data through end-to-end pre-training without relying on human-defined priors. This model allows the use of only a subset of 12.5% ​​of the experts (i.e., the fraction of the 8 active experts) on a specific task while maintaining performance close to the full model; when all 128 experts are used together, it still serves as a powerful general model. EMO has 1B active parameters and 14B total parameters, with training data reaching 1 trillion tokens. Compared with standard MoE, EMO encourages experts to form domain specialization groups through document-level routing constraints, thereby supporting selective use without causing serious performance degradation, achieving a composable architecture, and optimizing the memory-accuracy trade-off of large sparse MoE.

v4::en::Runway Agent 是一个集成化创意工具平台，旨在为用户提: Runway Agent is an integrated creative tool platform designed to provide users with a full set of resources and functions needed to realize any creative idea. The platform integrates a variety of artificial intelligence-driven tools such as video editing, image generation, and 3D modeling, allowing users to seamlessly complete the creative process from concept to finished product in one workflow. Its core feature is to lower the technical threshold for professional content production, allowing users to more freely transform ideas into visual works through automation and intelligent assistance functions.
v4::en::Runway公司遵循Thorn的\"生成式AI安全设计\"原则，: Runway follows Thorn's "generative AI safety design" principles to protect children from AI abuse throughout the entire process. Beginning with model development, we ensure the training data does not contain sexual content involving minors through hash matching, child safety classifiers, and LLM audits, as well as red team testing to identify vulnerabilities. Once the product is deployed, sexual content involving children is explicitly prohibited, user content is scanned using a multi-layered detection system, and all flagged content is manually reviewed and reported to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (516 submitted in 2025). At the same time, we implement C2PA source signal tracking content generation, and continue to cooperate with industry organizations to respond to threats.
v4::en::Runway开源了Python库confingy，旨在解决机器学: Runway open sourced the Python library confingy, aiming to solve the long-term pain points of machine learning system configuration. This library allows developers to replace traditional YAML configuration files with pure Python code (supporting lazy loading, type checking and serialization), thereby getting rid of the maintenance dilemma caused by YAML as a complete domain-specific language in Turing. Confingy can meet core needs such as tracking constructor parameters and avoiding instantiation of expensive objects (such as large language models) without refactoring existing code. It effectively improves development experience problems such as inability to jump to definitions, invalid type hints, and difficulty in refactoring due to complex YAML configurations.
v4::en::Runway正式发布Runway Agent，这是一个能够通过单: Runway officially launches Runway Agent, an intelligent creative partner that can transform creative ideas into complete, publishable videos in a single conversation. Users only need to describe their needs in natural language, and the Agent can autonomously complete concept proposals, story rhythm design, and visual direction planning based on context and goals, and ultimately generate a finished film containing multiple scenes, narration, dialogue, and music. It is designed to enable brand teams, marketers, creative agencies and filmmakers to quickly produce a variety of video content, such as brand promotions, social media materials and short films, reducing the traditional review and production cycle that takes days or weeks to just minutes. The product is now live, and new free plan users can earn 1,500 points toward making their first video.

v4::en::SenseNova-U1 技术报告详尽披露了构建前沿原生多模态模: The SenseNova-U1 technical report details the method of building cutting-edge native multi-modal models. The core includes native multi-modal unified modeling, lossless visual interface, joint autoregressive and pixel spatial flow matching training, and native hybrid expert backbone network. The report provides a complete practical guide to the six-stage training scheme, reinforcement learning post-training and distillation. v4::en::SimWorld Studio是一个基于Unreal Engin: SimWorld Studio is an open source platform based on Unreal Engine 5, designed to automatically generate dynamically evolving 3D interactive environments for embodied agent learning. Its core is the tool-enhanced coding agent SimCoder, which can write engine code according to instructions to build a physically real world, and evolves itself through verification feedback, corrects the environment, and accumulates reusable skills. The generated environment is exported with a standardized interface for agent training. The platform also realizes the co-evolution of environment generation and agent learning: based on the agent's performance feedback, SimCoder generates adaptive courses near its ability boundaries, so that the difficulty of the environment increases as the agent progresses. In the case of embodied navigation, this solution significantly improves the generalization performance of the agent.

v4::en::Statewright 是一个通过状态机为AI智能体提供约束的系: Statewright is a system that provides constraints for AI agents through state machines. It can control the tools it can use at each stage, thereby focusing on reasoning and improving reliability. It defines workflow as multiple stages such as planning, implementation, and testing, and automatically executes tool limits and status transitions. In the local model test, after applying constraints on the five SWE-bench subtasks of the two models, the accuracy rate significantly improved from 2/10 to 10/10. The system has been integrated into platforms such as Claude Code, and a typical workflow to fix a test failure can be completed in 46 seconds.

v4::en::一项新研究证明，一个通过强化学习训练的7B语言模型能够有效指挥G: A new study proves that a 7B language model trained through reinforcement learning can effectively command cutting-edge large models such as GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro. By writing natural language subtasks, assigning them to different large models for execution, and accurately specifying context information, the model's performance comprehensively surpasses that of a single cutting-edge model in hard-core benchmarks such as GPQA Diamond, LiveCodeBench, and AIME25. The system only needs to call the large model about three times per problem on average, making it more efficient than manually designed multi-agent processes. This work provides key evidence that current commercial AI products that rely on manual prompt engineering and process design can fully implement end-to-end learning through reward signals alone. This reveals a new direction for AI development: the gap in intelligence may not lie in model size, but in the ability to coordinate and command.

v4::en::吸引子模型解决了循环Transformer训练不稳定、成本高和深: The attractor model solves the problems of unstable, high cost and fixed depth of cyclic Transformer training. It generates the initial output embedding through the backbone module, the attractor module iteratively optimizes the fixed point, and uses implicit differentiation to calculate the gradient, making the training memory independent of the effective depth and adaptive convergence of the iteration number. In language modeling, compared with the standard Transformer, the perplexity is reduced by up to 46.6%, the accuracy of downstream tasks is increased by up to 19.7%, and the training cost is lower; the performance of a 770M parameter model is better than that of the 1.3B parameter Transformer. In the inference task, with only about 1,000 examples, the 27 million parameter model achieved an accuracy of 91.4% and 93.1% on Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard respectively, which is better than leading models such as Claude and GPT o3. The model also exhibits the phenomenon of equilibrium internalization. After training, the initial output embedding is close to the equilibrium state. The solver can be removed during inference with almost no loss in performance, achieving the scalability of iterative optimization.

v4::en::现有无评论者RLHF方法通过算术平均聚合多目标奖励，易导致约束忽: Existing reviewer-free RLHF methods aggregate multi-objective rewards through arithmetic averaging, which easily leads to constraint neglect: a high score on a single objective may mask serious failures in other key objectives (such as security or format), thereby hiding low-performance bottleneck rewards that affect reliable alignment. This study proposes Reward Variance Policy Optimization (RVPO), a risk-sensitive framework that penalizes inter-reward variance in advantage aggregation and changes the optimization goal from "maximizing sum" to "maximizing consistency". Analysis shows that RVPO can effectively identify and increase the contribution of bottleneck rewards, and achieve more balanced policy optimization in multi-goal alignment tasks such as security and format compliance.

v4::en::由伯克利RDI、马克斯·普朗克安全与隐私研究所、Anthropi: A team composed of researchers from Berkeley RDI, the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google released a new benchmark called ExploitGym.该测试包含898个真实漏洞，要求AI智能体根据漏洞描述生成完整的漏洞利用程序。 The results show that cutting-edge AI models have been able to successfully exploit a considerable number of vulnerabilities, and some attacks can still succeed even after standard defense measures such as ASLR are enabled. This proves that AI has the ability to autonomously transform vulnerabilities into actual attacks. This technology has a dual purpose: it can not only help defenders assess the severity of vulnerabilities, but also potentially lower the technical threshold of attackers.
v4::en::研究人员提出文本条件联合嵌入预测架构（TC-JEPA），通过引入: The researchers proposed the Text Conditional Joint Embedding Prediction Architecture (TC-JEPA) to reduce visual uncertainty in mask feature prediction by introducing image description text as condition information. This method employs a fine-grained text conditioner to compute sparse cross-attention on input text markers to modulate the predicted image patch features. Compared with I-JEPA based on mask feature prediction, TC-JEPA can learn visual representations with richer semantics, solving the problem of insufficient semantic learning caused by visual uncertainty in the original method.
v4::en::研究发现，强化学习改进大语言模型推理时，并非教授新策略，而是对基: Research has found that when reinforcement learning improves large language model reasoning, it does not teach new strategies, but redistributes probabilities for solutions already mastered by the basic model. Its effective impact is only concentrated on 1-3% of high-entropy decision-making tokens, and the improved tokens are always among the top 5 alternatives of the basic model. Based on this, the researchers proposed the ReasonMaxxer method that does not require reinforcement learning. It only applies contrast loss at the decision point of entropy gating, requiring only hundreds of basic model deductions and no need for online generation. In multiple model and mathematical reasoning benchmark tests, this method reaches or exceeds the performance of full reinforcement learning, while training only requires dozens of questions and several minutes of single GPU time, and the cost is reduced by about three orders of magnitude.
v4::en::研究发现，部分已发布的模型存在有限的意外对思维链（CoT）进行评: Research has found that some published models have limited cases of unexpected chain-of-thought (CoT) scoring. The team has repaired the affected reward pathways and confirmed there is no clear evidence that the model's monitorability is reduced as a result. This shows that the impact of unexpected scoring on CoT in current reinforcement learning training is limited and does not have a negative impact on monitoring capabilities after repair.
v4::en::研究团队发布IndustryBench，这是一个基于中国国家标准: The research team released IndustryBench, a 2049-item Chinese industrial procurement Q&A benchmark based on Chinese national standards (GB/T) and industrial product records, and provides a multi-language aligned version. During construction, the verification process based on external search rejected 70.3% of large language model generation problems, highlighting the unreliability of model filtering alone. The evaluation of multi-language models found that: the best system score (0-3 point scale) is only 2.083 points, with huge room for improvement; "standards and terminology" are common capability shortcomings; extended reasoning will reduce the security adjustment scores of most models due to the introduction of unfounded security-critical details; security violation inspections will significantly change model rankings. Research shows that large language model evaluation in the industrial field needs to be based on source text and be security-conscious, rather than relying on simple aggregate accuracy.
v4::en::研究团队发布了开源肿瘤临床决策支持系统OncoAgent。该系统: The research team released the open source oncology clinical decision support system OncoAgent. The system uses a two-layer multi-agent framework, combines LangGraph topology and a four-stage Corrective RAG process to retrieve more than 70 authoritative clinical guidelines. Based on query complexity, the system routes tasks to a 9B parameter speed optimization model or a 27B parameter deep inference model, both of which were fine-tuned via QLoRA on AMD MI300X hardware using a data set containing more than 260,000 cases. The system enforces a strict zero protected health information policy and is secured with a three-layer reflective security validator, supporting fully on-premises deployment to protect patient data sovereignty.

v4::en::针对LLM多智能体系统在长程任务中因关键错误扩散导致整体失败的问: Aiming at the problem of overall failure of the LLM multi-agent system due to the proliferation of critical errors in long-distance tasks, this study proposes the online audit framework AgentForesight. The framework observes trajectory prefixes in real time during task execution and issues alerts at the earliest critical errors. The research constructed the AFTraj-2K trajectory corpus, and developed the AgentForesight-7B model based on this. The model is trained using a coarse-to-fine reinforcement learning strategy. In AFTraj-2K and external benchmarks, its performance surpasses leading proprietary models such as GPT-4.1, achieving performance improvements of up to +19.9% ​​and reducing step positioning errors by 3 times, thus shifting fault handling from post-hoc attribution to deployment-time intervention.
v4::en::针对离散流匹配生成文本需数百步迭代的问题，本研究提出轨迹塑形离散: Aiming at the problem that generating text through discrete flow matching requires hundreds of iterations, this study proposes a trajectory shaping discrete flow matching method. In traditional distillation, the quality of trajectories constructed from random jumps is the performance bottleneck. The new method introduces a lightweight "energy compass" that is evaluated during training and selects the most coherent candidate sequence to guide trajectory generation. This process only increases the training cost. In the 170 million-parameter language modeling task, the shaped 8-step student model was 32% less perplexed and 128 times faster than the 1024-step teacher model, and performed consistently across different data and model sizes. This method achieves the best perplexity over all compared baselines, including those using more data or larger models.

v4::en::ExploitGym:AI智能体能否将安全漏洞转化为真实攻击?。: ExploitGym: Can AI agents turn security vulnerabilities into real attacks?. A team composed of researchers from Berkeley RDI, Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google released a new benchmark called ExploitGym. The test contains 898 real vulnerabilities and requires the AI ​​agent to generate a complete exploit program based on the vulnerability description. The results show that cutting-edge AI models have been able to successfully exploit a considerable number of vulnerabilities, and some attacks can still succeed even after standard defense measures such as ASLR are enabled. This proves that AI has the ability to autonomously transform vulnerabilities into actual attacks. This technology has a dual purpose: it can help defenders assess the severity of vulnerabilities, and it may also lower the technical threshold of attackers. .

v5::en::EMO是一种新型专家混合模型，通过端到端预训练使模块化结构直接从: EMO is a new expert hybrid model that enables modular structures to emerge directly from data through end-to-end pre-training without relying on human-defined priors. This model allows the use of only a 12.5% ​​subset of experts (i.e., the fraction of the 8 active experts) on a specific task while maintaining performance close to the full model; when all 128 experts are used together, it still serves as a powerful general model. EMO has 1B active parameters and 14B total parameters, with training data reaching 1 trillion tokens. Compared with standard MoE, EMO encourages experts to form domain specialization groups through document-level routing constraints, thereby supporting selective use without causing serious performance degradation, achieving a composable architecture, and optimizing the memory-accuracy trade-off of large sparse MoE.

v5::en::Runway Agent 是一个集成化创意工具平台，旨在为用户提: Runway Agent is an integrated creative tool platform designed to provide users with a full set of resources and functions needed to realize any creative idea. The platform integrates a variety of artificial intelligence-driven tools such as video editing, image generation, and 3D modeling, allowing users to seamlessly complete the creative process from concept to finished product in one workflow. Its core feature is to lower the technical threshold for professional content production, allowing users to more freely transform ideas into visual works through automation and intelligent assistance functions.
v5::en::Runway公司遵循Thorn的\"生成式AI安全设计\"原则，: Runway follows Thorn's "generative AI safety design" principles to protect children from AI abuse throughout the entire process. Beginning with model development, we ensure the training data does not contain sexual content involving minors through hash matching, child safety classifiers, and LLM audits, as well as red team testing to identify vulnerabilities. Once the product is deployed, sexual content involving children is explicitly prohibited, user content is scanned using a multi-layered detection system, and all flagged content is manually reviewed and reported to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (516 submitted in 2025). At the same time, we implement C2PA source signal tracking content generation, and continue to cooperate with industry organizations to respond to threats.
v5::en::Runway开源了Python库confingy，旨在解决机器学: Runway open sourced the Python library confingy, aiming to solve the long-term pain points of machine learning system configuration. This library allows developers to replace traditional YAML configuration files with pure Python code (supporting lazy loading, type checking and serialization), thereby getting rid of the maintenance dilemma caused by YAML as a complete domain-specific language in Turing. Confingy can meet core needs such as tracking constructor parameters and avoiding instantiation of expensive objects (such as large language models) without refactoring existing code. It effectively improves development experience problems such as inability to jump to definitions, invalid type hints, and difficulty in refactoring due to complex YAML configurations.
v5::en::Runway正式发布Runway Agent，这是一个能够通过单: Runway officially launches Runway Agent, an intelligent creative partner that can transform creative ideas into complete, publishable videos in a single conversation. Users only need to describe their needs in natural language, and the Agent can autonomously complete concept proposals, story rhythm design, and visual direction planning based on context and goals, and ultimately generate a finished film containing multiple scenes, narration, dialogue, and music. It is designed to enable brand teams, marketers, creative agencies and filmmakers to quickly produce a variety of video content, such as brand promotions, social media materials and short films, reducing the traditional review and production cycle that takes days or weeks to just minutes. The product is now live, and new free plan users can earn 1,500 points toward making their first video.

v5::en::SimWorld Studio是一个基于Unreal Engin: SimWorld Studio is an open source platform based on Unreal Engine 5, designed to automatically generate dynamically evolving 3D interactive environments for embodied agent learning. Its core is the tool-enhanced coding agent SimCoder, which can write engine code according to instructions to build a physically real world, and evolves itself through verification feedback, corrects the environment, and accumulates reusable skills. The generated environment is exported with a standardized interface for agent training. The platform also realizes the co-evolution of environment generation and agent learning: based on the agent's performance feedback, SimCoder generates adaptive courses near its ability boundaries, so that the difficulty of the environment increases as the agent progresses. In the case of embodied navigation, this solution significantly improves the generalization performance of the agent.

v5::en::Statewright 是一个通过状态机为AI智能体提供约束的系: Statewright is a system that provides constraints for AI agents through state machines. It can control the tools it can use at each stage, thereby focusing on reasoning and improving reliability. It defines workflow as multiple stages such as planning, implementation, and testing, and automatically executes tool limits and state transitions. In the local model test, after applying constraints on the five SWE-bench subtasks of the two models, the accuracy rate significantly improved from 2/10 to 10/10. The system has been integrated into platforms such as Claude Code, and a typical workflow to fix a test failure can be completed in 46 seconds.

v5::en::Velox提出一个学习4D对象潜在表示的框架，该表示具备描述性、: Velox proposes a framework for learning latent representations of 4D objects that are descriptive, compressible, and accessible. It requires only unstructured dynamic point clouds as input, compresses spatiotemporal color point clouds into dynamic shape markers through an encoder, and utilizes two complementary decoders for supervision: a 4D surface decoder models the time-varying surface distribution to capture geometric information, and a Gaussian decoder is responsible for appearance reconstruction. This approach improves the efficiency of downstream tasks while maintaining high fidelity.

v5::en::一项新研究证明，一个通过强化学习训练的7B语言模型能够有效指挥G: A new study proves that a 7B language model trained through reinforcement learning can effectively command cutting-edge large models such as GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro. By writing natural language subtasks, assigning them to different large models for execution, and accurately specifying context information, the model's performance comprehensively surpasses that of a single cutting-edge model in hard-core benchmarks such as GPQA Diamond, LiveCodeBench, and AIME25. The system only needs to call the large model about three times per problem on average, making it more efficient than manually designed multi-agent processes. This work provides key evidence that current commercial AI products that rely on manual prompt engineering and process design can fully implement end-to-end learning through reward signals alone. This reveals a new direction for AI development: the gap in intelligence may not lie in model size, but in the ability to coordinate and command.

v5::en::吸引子模型解决了循环Transformer训练不稳定、成本高和深: The attractor model solves the problems of unstable, high cost and fixed depth of cyclic Transformer training. It generates the initial output embedding through the backbone module, the attractor module iteratively optimizes the fixed point, and uses implicit differentiation to calculate the gradient, making the training memory independent of the effective depth and adaptive convergence of the iteration number. In language modeling, compared with the standard Transformer, the perplexity is reduced by up to 46.6%, the accuracy of downstream tasks is increased by up to 19.7%, and the training cost is lower; the performance of a 770M parameter model is better than that of the 1.3B parameter Transformer. In the inference task, with only about 1,000 examples, the 27 million parameter model achieved an accuracy of 91.4% and 93.1% on Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard, respectively, which is better than leading models such as Claude and GPT o3. The model also exhibits the phenomenon of equilibrium internalization. After training, the initial output embedding is close to the equilibrium state. The solver can be removed during inference with almost no loss in performance, achieving the scalability of iterative optimization.

v5::en::现有无评论者RLHF方法通过算术平均聚合多目标奖励，易导致约束忽: Existing reviewer-free RLHF methods aggregate multi-objective rewards through arithmetic averaging, which easily leads to constraint neglect: a high score on a single objective may mask serious failures in other key objectives (such as security or format), thereby hiding low-performance bottleneck rewards that affect reliable alignment. This study proposes Reward Variance Policy Optimization (RVPO), a risk-sensitive framework that penalizes inter-reward variance in advantage aggregation and changes the optimization goal from "maximizing sum" to "maximizing consistency". Analysis shows that RVPO can effectively identify and increase the contribution of bottleneck rewards, and achieve more balanced policy optimization in multi-goal alignment tasks such as security and format compliance.
v5::en::由伯克利RDI、马克斯·普朗克安全与隐私研究所、Anthropi: A team composed of researchers from Berkeley RDI, the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google released a new benchmark called ExploitGym. The test contains 898 real vulnerabilities and requires the AI ​​agent to generate a complete exploit program based on the vulnerability description. The results show that cutting-edge AI models have been able to successfully exploit a considerable number of vulnerabilities, and some attacks can still succeed even after standard defense measures such as ASLR are enabled. This proves that AI has the ability to autonomously transform vulnerabilities into actual attacks. This technology has a dual purpose: it can not only help defenders assess the severity of vulnerabilities, but also potentially lower the technical threshold of attackers.
v5::en::研究团队发布IndustryBench，这是一个基于中国国家标准: The research team released IndustryBench, a 2049-item Chinese industrial procurement Q&A benchmark based on Chinese national standards (GB/T) and industrial product records, and provides a multi-language aligned version. During construction, the verification process based on external search rejected 70.3% of large language model generation problems, highlighting the unreliability of model filtering alone. The evaluation of multi-language models found that: the best system score (0-3 point scale) is only 2.083 points, with huge room for improvement; "standards and terminology" are common capability shortcomings; extended reasoning will reduce the security adjustment scores of most models due to the introduction of unfounded security-critical details; security violation inspections will significantly change model rankings. Research shows that large language model evaluation in the industrial field needs to be based on source text and be security-conscious, rather than relying on simple aggregate accuracy.
v5::en::研究团队发布了开源肿瘤临床决策支持系统OncoAgent。该系统: The research team released the open source oncology clinical decision support system OncoAgent. The system uses a two-layer multi-agent framework, combines LangGraph topology and a four-stage Corrective RAG process to retrieve more than 70 authoritative clinical guidelines. Based on query complexity, the system routes tasks to a 9B parameter speed optimization model or a 27B parameter deep inference model, both of which were fine-tuned via QLoRA on AMD MI300X hardware using a data set containing more than 260,000 cases. The system enforces a strict zero protected health information policy and is secured with a three-layer reflective security validator, supporting fully on-premises deployment to protect patient data sovereignty.

v5::en::谷歌团队通过Fitbit对近1.4万名用户进行了为期9个月的AI: The Google team conducted a nine-month AI symptom-checking test on nearly 14,000 users through Fitbit. In the blind evaluation, 53% of clinicians ranked AI diagnosis as their first choice, significantly higher than the 24% of independent doctors. The core finding of the research is not that "AI beats doctors", but reveals that current large consumer-level models (such as ChatGPT), which only rely on user input to directly answer questions, are flawed - their diagnostic accuracy is about 27% lower than that of AI-led structured interviews. At the same time, wearable devices can detect physiological changes such as increased heart rate and sleep disorders several days in advance, before users actively report symptoms. This shows that the future development direction of medical diagnosis is the combination of conversational AI that actively inquires and sensors that provide early warning.

v5::en::针对LLM多智能体系统在长程任务中因关键错误扩散导致整体失败的问: Aiming at the problem of overall failure of the LLM multi-agent system due to the proliferation of critical errors in long-distance tasks, this study proposes the online audit framework AgentForesight. The framework observes trajectory prefixes in real time during task execution and issues alerts at the earliest critical errors. The research constructed the AFTraj-2K trajectory corpus, and developed the AgentForesight-7B model based on this. The model is trained using a coarse-to-fine reinforcement learning strategy. In AFTraj-2K and external benchmarks, its performance surpasses leading proprietary models such as GPT-4.1, achieving performance improvements of up to +19.9% ​​and reducing step positioning errors by 3 times, thus shifting fault handling from post-hoc attribution to deployment-time intervention.
v5::en::针对离散流匹配生成文本需数百步迭代的问题，本研究提出轨迹塑形离散: Aiming at the problem that generating text through discrete flow matching requires hundreds of iterations, this study proposes a trajectory shaping discrete flow matching method. In traditional distillation, the quality of trajectories constructed from random jumps is the performance bottleneck. The new method introduces a lightweight "energy compass" that is evaluated during training and selects the most coherent candidate sequence to guide trajectory generation. This process only increases the training cost. In the 170 million-parameter language modeling task, the shaped 8-step student model was 32% less perplexed and 128 times faster than the 1024-step teacher model, and performed consistently across different data and model sizes. This method achieves the best perplexity over all compared baselines, including those using more data or larger models.

v5::en::OpenAI 介绍了为 Windows 上的 Codex 编程代: When the Codex team began work on Windows in late 2025, users had no sandbox option, forcing them to either approve every command or grant full access. Existing Windows isolation tools like AppContainer, Windows Sandbox, and Mandatory Integrity Control labeling were each unfit for an open-ended developer agent, so OpenAI built a custom sandbox using synthetic security identifiers and write-restricted tokens, granting Codex scoped file-write and network access without requiring administrator elevation.
v5::zh::Simon Willison shares a quote fr: Simon Willison 引用 Boris Mann 的一句话，指出说自己有十一个 AI agent 几乎没有任何意义，就像说有十一张电子表格或十一个浏览器标签一样空洞。仅凭数量并不能说明这些代理在做什么或完成了多少工作，这一观点反对把 agent 数量当作衡量 AI 工作流价值的指标。
v5::en::Simon Willison 引用 Boris Mann 的一句: Simon Willison shares a quote from Boris Mann arguing that the phrase 11 AI agents is meaningless on its own. Saying you have 11 AI agents tells someone about as much as saying you have 11 spreadsheets or 11 browser tabs open. The count alone reveals nothing about what they do or how much work they accomplish, pushing back on agent-count metrics as a substantive way to describe AI workflows.

v5::en::ExploitGym:AI智能体能否将安全漏洞转化为真实攻击?。: ExploitGym: Can AI agents turn security vulnerabilities into real attacks?. A team composed of researchers from Berkeley RDI, the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google released a new benchmark called ExploitGym. The test contains 898 real vulnerabilities and requires the AI ​​agent to generate a complete exploit program based on the vulnerability description. The results show that cutting-edge AI models have been able to successfully exploit a considerable number of vulnerabilities, and some attacks can still succeed even after standard defense measures such as ASLR are enabled. This proves that AI has the ability to autonomously transform vulnerabilities into actual attacks. This technology has a dual purpose: it can not only help defenders assess the severity of vulnerabilities, but also potentially lower the technical threshold of attackers. .

v5::en::FAAST提出了一种仅需前向传播的关联适应方法，通过解析方式将标: FAAST proposes an association adaptation method that requires only forward propagation, and parses annotated samples into fast weights in a single pass without relying on memory or context. This approach enables constant-time inference and decouples task adaptation from pre-trained representations. In image classification and language modeling benchmarks, FAAST performance matches or exceeds backpropagation-based adaptation methods while reducing adaptation time by more than 90%; performance is comparable to memory/context-based adaptation methods, but memory usage can be saved by up to 95%. This provides an efficient and scalable solution for supervised task adaptation, especially for resource-constrained models.

v5::en::NousResearch发布了Token Superpositi: NousResearch has released Token Superposition Training (TST), a method to improve the standard large language model pre-training process. This technology can achieve 2-3 times faster training time with the same computational load (FLOPs) without changing the model architecture, optimizer, tokenizer or training data. Its core is to have the model read and predict consecutive token packets during the first third of training, average the input embeddings, and predict the next token packet using an improved cross-entropy loss; the remaining training time reverts to standard next token prediction. The model in the inference phase is exactly the same as the model produced by traditional pre-training. The method has been validated at 270M, 600M, 3B dense models, and 10B to 1B mixed expert model scales.

v5::en::当前软件工程智能体评估仅依赖最终补丁是否通过测试的二元信号，掩盖: Current software engineering agent evaluation relies solely on binary signals of whether the final patch passes testing, masking differences in solution quality. The study analyzed 2,614 trajectories and found that of the 1,815 evaluable pass trajectories, 10.7% were "lucky passes", manifested by problems such as regression loops and blind retries. To this end, the research team proposed the AgentLens framework for process-level evaluation, and released the AgentLens-Bench data set annotated with quality scores, redundant signals and other information. Based on the quality score, passing trajectories are divided into three levels: lucky, solid and ideal, with the lucky passing rate of different models ranging from 0.5% to 23.2%. When ranked by quality score rather than pass rate, the rankings of some models change significantly. Related resources have been open source.

The core of it is to expand refined human-AI collaborative supervision rather than simply expanding the model size. This study (selected as a CVPR 2026 highlight paper) points out that current mainstream video generation models have obvious deficiencies in understanding and generating professional cinematic camera movements (such as Hitchcockian sliding zooms, precise focus shifts, or Dutch angle shots), often producing generic or incorrectly focused images. This work reveals a new path to enhance the model's "movie language" expressive ability by improving the quality of supervision.
v5::en::研究提出了一种探索感知的强化学习框架，使LLM智能体能够在不确定: The research proposes an exploration-aware reinforcement learning framework that enables LLM agents to conduct adaptive exploration only when uncertainty is high. This method designs a fine-grained reward function through variational reasoning, evaluates the potential of exploratory actions to improve future decisions, and introduces an exploration-aware grouping mechanism to separate exploratory actions from task completion actions during the optimization process. Experiments show that the method achieves sustained performance improvements in a series of text- and GUI-based agent benchmarks. The relevant code and models have been open sourced on GitHub and HuggingFace platforms.

v5::en::针对多跳检索增强生成（RAG）中推理过程隐式、检索漂移及错误难以: In order to solve the problems of implicit inference process, retrieval drift and difficult self-checking of errors in multi-hop retrieval enhanced generation (RAG), the research team proposed the PyRAG framework to reconstruct the multi-hop inference task into a program synthesis and execution process. This framework writes the reasoning steps as executable Python programs, and implements multi-step calculations by explicitly calling retrieval and question-and-answer tools, making intermediate states variable, feedback deterministic, and generating a complete and checkable reasoning trajectory. This method supports compiler-based self-healing and execution-driven adaptive retrieval without additional training. In five question and answer benchmarks including PopQA and HotpotQA, PyRAG significantly outperformed the baseline model in both no-training and reinforcement learning training settings, especially on the combined multi-hop data set. Related resources have been open source.
v5::en::针对大语言模型在科学写作中生成看似合理但无法验证的虚假引用问题，: To address the problem of large language models generating seemingly reasonable but unverifiable false citations in scientific writing, the research team built a cascaded multi-agent detector called CiteTracer. The system redefines citation hallucination detection as a field-level determination consistent with the taxonomy and introduces a classification system with 12 codes covering real, potential and hallucinated citations. CiteTracer retrieves evidence through multiple channels such as structured extraction, cache lookups, URL acquisition, academic connectors, and web searches, applies deterministic field matching, and routes fuzzy cases to professional classification judges. On a benchmark containing 2450 synthetic citations and 957 forged citations from real conference submissions, CiteTracer achieved an overall accuracy of 97.1% on the synthetic set and detected 97.1% of forged citations on the real set. The relevant code has been open source.

The research team worked with more than a hundred professional creators for a year to build a video description generation process. v5::en::下一篇， NousResearch推出Token Superpo: Next article, NousResearch launches Token Superposition Training technology to significantly accelerate the pre-training of large language models. NousResearch has released Token Superposition Training (TST), a method to improve the standard large language model pre-training process. This technology can achieve 2-3 times faster training time with the same computational load (FLOPs) without changing the model architecture, optimizer, tokenizer or training data. Its core is to have the model read and predict consecutive token packets during the first third of training, average the input embeddings, and predict the next token packet using an improved cross-entropy loss; the remaining training time reverts to standard next token prediction. The model in the inference phase is exactly the same as the model produced by traditional pre-training. The method has been validated at 270M, 600M, 3B dense models, and 10B to 1B mixed expert model scales. .

v5::zh::We’re in a period where everythi:
我们正处于一个感觉一切都在角色之间变得混乱的时期，因为人工智能可以让你更轻松地探索其他功能的相邻性。

我们所有人都必须共同找出这些工作在代理世界中的新定义形式，当然许多工作看起来与以前的工作有所不同。但有些永恒的法则最终会随着时间的推移重新出现并再次变得清晰。 

举个例子，当你进行扩展时，产品经理应该花大量的时间与客户在一起，获取产品的反馈，并思考下一步要做什么，如何设计它以使其可用，等等。工程师应该了解业务目标，并构建可扩展且安全的系统，即使功能速度提高了 10 倍也是如此。现在，两者都可以承担更多的其他角色，这可能会暂时与完成整个事情混为一谈，但最终工作加起来就足够了，再次专业化是有意义的。

同样，在 GTM 中，产品营销人员当然可以为发布生成工作设计和视频，但专家始终（或应该）关注能够提供更好结果的质量。

我敢打赌，人工智能会进一步增强专业化，即使一些角色相互融合，并且专家未来的工具链和技术将比该功能的其他任何业余爱好者拥有更高的杠杆率和产出。

v5::en::本文提出一种将预训练推理模型转化为严格奥赛求解器的统一方法。该方: This paper proposes a unified approach to transform pre-trained inference models into rigorous Olympiad solvers. The method first uses an inverse perplexity course for supervised fine-tuning to instill rigorous proof search and self-checking behaviors; then extends these capabilities through a two-stage reinforcement learning process, and finally combines test-time expansion to improve performance. The 30B parameter model SU-01 trained based on this solution can stably handle long-trajectory problems of more than 100,000 tokens after using only about 340,000 short trajectories for fine-tuning and 200 steps of reinforcement learning. It has achieved gold medal-level performance in mathematics and physics Olympiads such as IMO, USAMO, and IPhO, and has also demonstrated strong reasoning generalization capabilities to scientific fields other than mathematical physics.

v5::en::研究团队推出MEMLENS基准，系统评估大型视觉语言模型在多模态: The research team launched the MEMLENS benchmark to systematically evaluate the long-term memory capabilities of large-scale visual language models in multi-modal multi-turn conversations. The benchmark contains 789 questions covering the five major memory abilities and tested at four standard context lengths. After evaluating 27 long context models and 7 memory enhancement agents, it was found that: the long context model performed well in short conversations but performance declined as the conversation lengthened; the memory agent length stability was good but visual fidelity was lost. Multi-round inference tasks limit the performance of most systems to less than 30%, indicating the need for hybrid architectures that combine long-context attention with structured multi-modal retrieval.

v5::en::针对传统检索无法理解复杂意图、而前沿大语言模型成本高且存在幻觉的: In order to solve the problem that traditional retrieval cannot understand complex intentions, and cutting-edge large language models are costly and have hallucinations, the research team proposed a self-evolving intelligent document retrieval system PaSaMaster. The system transforms document retrieval into a dynamic evolution process through iterative intent analysis, retrieval and sorting, and adopts three key designs: it uses sorting evidence to reveal information gaps to optimize search; it defines retrieval as an intent-paper relevance ranking task, fundamentally eliminating false documents; it improves efficiency by separating planning and retrieval, using only large models to understand intent, and leaving large-scale retrieval and scoring to lightweight models. In a benchmark test covering 38 subjects, the system increased the F1 score of traditional keyword retrieval by 15.6 times, completely eliminating the document illusion, and its performance exceeded GPT-5.2 by 30%, with a computational cost of only 1% of the latter.

Finally, Claude Code improved the record to 2930 steps, surpassing the human benchmark of 2990 steps. Experiments show that the agent is extremely efficient in systematically integrating mainstream optimization methods in the community, performing hyperparameter scanning and strategy combination, but it fails to break through the baseline in the "novelty check" link that requires real innovation. The project makes all experimental records, logs and codes open source, transforming AI autonomous research from concept to reproducible reality. .
